cues.en: Instructor: This video is an unsupervised learning challenge, So what you want to do here is compute the R-Squared of this model and the F-Statistic for this model.
cues.zh: 講師：這支影片是無監督學習挑戰，要計算這個模型的 R 平方與 F 統計量。

cues.en: Now, I didn't show you in the code how to compute that manually.
cues.zh: 我沒有在程式中示範如何手動計算。

cues.en: We can get it out from the regress function, and I showed you in the video, you might remember it was the R-Squared was 0.36 and the F-Statistic was 4.54,
cues.zh: 可以從 regress 函式取得；影片中展示過，你可能記得 R 平方是 0.36，F 統計量是 4.54。

cues.en: but what I want you to do in this challenge is not just, you know, figure out how to get these as outputs from the MATLAB function or the Python function.
cues.zh: 但這個挑戰，不只是想辦法從 MATLAB 或 Python 函式輸出取得它們。

cues.en: Instead, I want you to remember the formulas or check back to the formulas that you learned about, I guess it was three videos ago, the video about evaluating the regression models
cues.zh: 而是回想，或回頭查看大概三支影片之前，「評估迴歸模型」影片中學到的公式，

cues.en: and implement the formulas for R-Squared and the F-Statistic and make sure that you can compute an R-Squared and F-Statistic for these data, this example data
cues.zh: 實作 R 平方與 F 統計量公式，確保能對這份範例資料計算 R 平方與 F 統計量，

cues.en: and you should be able to get the same number that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 應該得到與投影片展示相同的數字。
